Why
The existing frontend offers browser and device-code Codex login. The extracted app-server client currently exposes account reads/refresh/logout but cannot drive those login workflows through Host custody.

## Changes
Add finite typed account/login/start, account/login/cancel and private completion observation. Preserve native login IDs, unknown acceptance and no replay. The consumer keeps browser presentation, early-ID correlation, process custody, credential ownership and account readback. Session SPI and conversation event delivery remain compatible.

## Validation
Node 24.21.0 / pnpm 11.18.0: pnpm check passed (build, typecheck, 509 source tests and both packed consumers). The subprocess protocol suite covers 7 login cases. Node 26.11.1 / pnpm 11.18.0 also passed the complete check (509 source tests and both packed consumers). The retained packed-consumer artifact has SHA-256 `691a7a62cdd5a92e2edb120f2c409790c9ca16215495cdf9daa099b3b8748bd9`; the Session SPI archive is byte-identical to the frontend's current pin. This is protocol evidence, not vendor authentication or Desktop UI acceptance.

Frontend integration: https://github.com/777genius/agent-teams-ai/pull/1186
Plan: docs/plans/provider-migration/frontend-parity-2026-11-12/01-codex-login.md in that repository.

selectedSourceConclusions.finding: The five original fields stage/reason/elapsedMs/deadlineExpired/aborted and their first capture point remain byte-identical. The publication builds a new frozen six-field scalar record; the original failure record is not mutated.

The outer catch still aborts and throws the same actual error object. No additional rejection replacement or cleanup promotion is introduced. Existing raw injected-error translation remains unchanged.

The first after-session invalid_native_read_response remains the first diagnostic reason; an unknown-cleanup sibling can independently select finalReason native_read_cleanup_unknown. The settled-rejection branch retains the first Error identity.

No additional Date.now, timer, fetch, read, await, abort or cleanup call is added by this delta. The original single 30000 ms read-cut deadline and remaining-time arguments are unchanged, as are the two existing 1000 ms cleanup caps. This is not a claim that cleanup adds no time outside the read budget, or that synchronous observers have a universal latency bound.
The same close() cached Promise is returned before/after completion. The change adds no second close operation, confirmation, replay or diagnostic emission on later calls.

The event has exactly stage, outcome, trustedBinding. Stage has 3 local literals; outcome has 2 literals; binding must be a primitive lowercase 64-hex own data value and engine must be own data opencode-v2. The binding is a correlation label only; no process or cancellation authority is granted.

No subscribers means no newly observed config descriptor reads. V1, missing/inherited/accessor/malformed fields and throwing descriptor traps skip the event without changing the original close receipt. Producer-owned synchronous validation/publication throws are contained.

No arbitrary-subscriber isolation or latency guarantee is established. The committed plan explicitly preserves synchronous diagnostics_channel semantics and the test labels its mocked publisher throw as distinct from an arbitrary subscriber uncaughtException. A later collector must bound/contain its own callback work.

Only the two implementation modules and two existing suites change. The full tree proves no package/export/dependency/workflow/archive/dist/contract or other source leaf changes. Shared owner changes are guarded to V2 observations; caller lifecycle/custody and product authority remain outside these diagnostics.

outstandingBoundaries: Diagnostic instrumentation identifies existing first/final read reasons and failed close stages; it does not repair the unresolved native I/O/custody cause or convert UNKNOWN into confirmed cleanup.

A stage names the failing original bounded await. An original-work timeout does not establish underlying promise settlement; final read Promise.allSettled also does not certify physical cleanup of a late/uncooperative operation.
The source preserves original read and close timeout arguments. Synchronous subscriber work remains synchronous; no universal observer error or latency isolation is claimed.

A future consumer must treat finalReason as optional: absence or invalidity of the added value must not invalidate a valid original producer event; the original fields remain usable at their original scope. Close trustedBinding is for exact correlation only, and missing/mismatched/ambiguous close telemetry is inconclusive. Consumer code/adoption was not selected or audited here.

No compiler/test/pnpm check/native/CI result was obtained. AGENTS.md asks for pnpm check before implementation delivery; this narrowly authorized immutable read-only audit is not implementation delivery and executes nothing.
